required_checks.assumptions: Certify deterministic q#pi*, binning, realizability, RTVC, and global P-IISS.
required_checks.horizon: At least six geometric H values spanning a factor of 32.
required_checks.stable: Exact stable propagation is polynomial and fits a power model materially better than an exponential model.
required_checks.unstable_control: An alpha=2 negative control violates horizon-independent P-IISS and fits exponential growth.
required_checks.epsilon: At least seven epsilon_q values are varied independently of H and yield exponent one.
required_checks.independent_checker: A separate rational-recurrence implementation must reproduce the decisive values and model selection.

decision: VERIFIED only if every required check and the independent checker pass; otherwise BLOCKED.
